//: TODO(design): the first mutations (GAME_DESIGN.md §12), written by Claude for M6; names, texts and numbers are working values, change them freely. A mutation is a mark on the hydra that her heiresses can inherit (a random half of her mutations, rounded up: lineage.json inheritedShare). It comes from some events (an outcome with "mutation") and from a marking shrine of the Serpent (shrines.json marks). effects, all optional, negative numbers are the catch: movement (points per turn), sight (hexes), bodyMaxHp, regeneration (body HP healed per turn), headMaxHpPercent (every head's max HP, in percent), startingHeads (heads a hydra hatches with; only from the next generation on, never fewer than 1), alertPercent (the Alert rises this many percent faster; negative = slower), findsPercent (more Muck and Moisture from deposits and springs, in percent), echoRange (echoes are heard this many hexes further). In M6 only effects on the map and the hydra's numbers; mutations that work in battle (e.g. Fireproof Scales) come after M2a.

mutations.name: Thick-necked
mutations.text: The necks are thicker than they need to be. The heads find this reassuring, and say so.

mutations.name: Paranoid
mutations.text: One head always faces backwards, and is right about the Order more often than is comfortable. It hatches alone, so it can keep an eye on the others.

mutations.name: Long-bodied
mutations.text: A body made for long tunnels. There is more of it at both ends and rather less in the middle.

mutations.name: Slow Blood
mutations.text: Wounds close slowly, but they close. So does everything else.

mutations.name: Bog-scented
mutations.text: Smells so exactly like the swamp that the Order takes a while to notice the swamp is moving. The smell gets in the eyes.

mutations.name: Hoarder's Gut
mutations.text: Finds Muck everywhere and keeps all of it. Rattles faintly when it walks.

mutations.name: Many-mouthed
mutations.text: Hatches with one head more than strictly necessary. The necks are thinner for it, and so is the conversation.

mutations.name: Echo-eared
mutations.text: Hears the deep places talking from far off. Mostly they talk about her.
